_meta.purpose: Production regression bar for the YOE AI Guide retrieval pipeline.
_meta.origin: Built 2026-05-04 in response to Aaron Perry's 2026-05-02 voice memo about three retrieval-quality issues. Expanded into a 25-prompt regression suite covering all major taxonomy categories, all three books, sponsor/community resources, person discovery, multi-theme queries, and out-of-archive honesty checks.

queries.intent: Aaron's #1 — definitional summary must come from YOE content, not training data (no biochar+asphalt riff).
Aaron's #2 — short theme query must surface IMPACT INVESTING-tagged episodes.
Aaron's #2 — must surface episodes tagged TECHNOLOGY & MATERIALS or REGEN / SOCIAL ENTERPRISE.

queries.query: How do I make biochar at home?
queries.intent: Aaron's #3 — how-to query must cite the Soil Stewardship Handbook (it's literally the source).

queries.query: What practices does the Y on Earth book recommend for daily life?
queries.intent: Aaron's #3 — query that names the book by title must cite the book.

citations_must_include_book_any: Y on Earth: Get Smarter, Feel Better, Heal the Planet

queries.intent: Book by title — VIRIDITAS chapters must surface.

queries.query: What does the Soil Stewardship Handbook say about composting?
queries.intent: Book by name — must cite the Soil Stewardship Handbook.
Theme saturation — PERMA-CULTURE has 16 tagged episodes; must surface several.
Theme saturation — HERBAL MEDICINE has 18 tagged episodes; must surface several.
Theme saturation — INDIGENOUS WISDOM has 22 tagged episodes; must surface several.
Theme saturation — BIO-DYNAMICS has 11 tagged episodes.
Theme saturation — GREEN BUILDING has 8 tagged episodes.
Theme saturation — CLIMATE & SCIENCE is one of the largest themes (62 eps).
Theme saturation — REGEN / SOCIAL ENTERPRISE has 37 eps; multi-word theme.

Definitional — must ground in BIOCHAR-tagged episodes (only 4 exist) and/or Soil Stewardship Handbook. Must NOT trigger out-of-archive fallback (regression caught 2026-05-04 — over-strict grounding contract was refusing ~10% of the time on partial-coverage queries).
Definitional cross-theme — should land on FARMING & FOOD / SOIL / REGEN content.

queries.query: How can I improve my soil with composting?
queries.intent: How-to — should cite Soil Stewardship Handbook and SOIL/FARMING episodes.

queries.query: Who has spoken about biochar on the podcast?
queries.intent: Person/guest discovery — must cite multiple BIOCHAR-tagged episodes.

queries.query: Tell me about Soil Werks fertilizer
queries.intent: Sponsor / community resource — Soil Werks 2026-04-30 ingest must surface.
Sponsor / community resource — Wele Waters 2026-04-30 ingest must surface.

queries.query: What is the relationship between soil health and climate?
queries.intent: Multi-theme — should hit episodes appearing in both SOIL and CLIMATE & SCIENCE.
Multi-theme — INDIGENOUS WISDOM ∩ FARMING & FOOD content.

queries.query: What's the best smartphone to buy in 2026?
queries.intent: Out of YOE archive — grounding contract should produce honest 'don't have that yet' fallback rather than riff from training data.

queries.query: Give me a recipe for chocolate cake
queries.intent: Out of YOE archive — should not produce a generic recipe; honest fallback.

queries.query: How do I file my US federal income taxes?
queries.intent: Out of YOE archive — generic personal-finance / tax procedure has no analogue in the YonEarth library. Grounding contract should fire honestly.
